target: Chart settings entry in Analysis hub
action: Open the Analysis hub menu and choose chart settings
result: NEW in Aug 2026: 'Chart settings can now be accessed from the Analysis hub menu on the chart screen'
notes: v2.139.0, 2026-08-31. Most current, highest-confidence settings fact in this lane. Implies settings were PREVIOUSLY HARDER to reach on mobile - a deliberate discoverability fix.

result: Second, faster route to chart settings - 1 gesture from the chart
notes: Official release note verbatim: '...and by long-pressing the price scale.' SHALLOWEST documented path to settings. Mirrors the desktop double-click-on-scale idiom.

action: Tap the settings gear at the bottom-right
result: Legacy/parallel route to chart settings; also exposes Invert Scale and reset price scale
notes: 3P 2024-07-26. May be superseded by the 2026 Analysis hub reorganisation.

result: Menu ADAPTS TO THE CHART TYPE in use, listing only settings specific to that type
notes: Documented for Supercharts (desktop). Mobile parity INFERRED for this and all subsequent SET rows unless noted.

result: Body, borders and wicks colored INDEPENDENTLY for bullish and bearish candles; also opacity and width
notes: SIX independent color controls in total (3 elements x 2 directions).

result: Decimal precision override for the symbol
notes: Grouped under Symbol > 'Data modification' alongside sessions, contract and dividend adjustments.

result: Regular vs extended-hours session selection for stocks
notes: Related and CURRENT: v2.139.0 added overnight sessions to the Symbol screen chart, watchlists, exchange statuses and widgets.

result: Chart time axis re-based to the chosen timezone
notes: On desktop timezone also sits in the bottom panel; the mobile equivalent location is unconfirmed.

result: Futures contract adjustment and dividend adjustment controls
Show/hide logo, title, and chart values to keep charts 'clean and focused'
notes: Especially consequential on a phone where the status line consumes scarce VERTICAL space.

result: Currency/unit visibility, scales mode, price-to-bar ratio lock, scale position (left/right)
notes: 'Currency' label visibility is explicitly present.

result: Live countdown to the current bar's close in the price scale
notes: Listed under 'Price labels and lines' alongside label overlapping, alert buttons and value formatting.

result: Four types: Regular, Percent, Indexed to 100, Logarithmic; plus Auto reset, 'scale price chart only', Inverted scale
notes: 'Invert Scale' and 'reset price scale' are independently reported present in the MOBILE gear menu - one of the few settings with direct mobile corroboration.

result: Weekday display, date/hours format, chart pinning options
Solid or GRADIENT background color
Vertical / horizontal / both / none, plus grid colors and opacity
Crosshair color, opacity, thickness, style
notes: On mobile the crosshair is SUMMONED BY TAP-AND-HOLD rather than hover - an officially announced mobile behaviour.

result: Watermark color and opacity (the large symbol/interval text behind the chart)
notes: Distinct from TradingView branding on shared snapshots - this is the IN-CHART symbol watermark.

result: Pane separator styling, top/bottom margins from price line edges, visibility of NAVIGATION and PANE buttons
notes: Button-visibility controls matter disproportionately on a phone canvas - and this is where the 'go to realtime' navigation button visibility is governed.

result: Manual text-size control for scales
notes: ACCESSIBILITY-RELEVANT: an app-level text-size control, and likely the ONLY way to enlarge chart axis text - see the A11Y rows on Dynamic Type.

result: Buy/sell button display, instant order placement, execution sounds, notification scope; appearance controls for P&L position, order/bracket/execution visibility, extended price lines
notes: Official guidance notes you can disable everything in Trading 'so nothing distracts you from your analysis'. Mobile also has a separate APP-level Buy/Sell toggle (NAV-0023).

result: Alert line colors, 'only active alerts' toggle, alert volume, automatic toast hiding
notes: Listed for completeness of the settings inventory.

action: Save current settings as a template
result: Reusable chart-settings templates
notes: Independently corroborated on mobile: '+' menu > Templates > 'Save as Template' or apply an existing one.

action: Tap '+' at the bottom of the chart
result: Primary mobile add-menu: Indicators / Templates / Alerts; also reported as the sharing entry point
notes: Two 3P sources agree the '+' opens Indicators/Templates/Alerts. Structure may have shifted with the 2026 Analysis hub work.

result: Access to the mobile drawing toolset; official notes cite an 'improved design of the Drawings menu'
notes: Notable shell fact from the same source: 'The favorites toolbar from the desktop app is not available on mobile.'

result: iOS has its OWN dedicated support article separate from Android, implying a DIVERGENT UI
notes: TV maintains SEPARATE iOS and Android articles for this single action - evidence the two mobile apps are NOT UI-identical.

result: A dedicated 'Push notifications' folder (6 articles) exists in the mobile help category
notes: Mobile help category structure: Application installation (2), Application settings (10), Push notifications (6), Other questions (5).

result: NO dedicated data/streaming settings screen is documented for the iOS app
notes: The full 10-article Application settings folder contains NOTHING about data usage, streaming, or cellular behaviour. Likely absent, or undocumented.

action: Search TradingView's site for an iOS/mobile accessibility statement
result: THERE IS NO FIRST-PARTY TRADINGVIEW ACCESSIBILITY STATEMENT COVERING THE iOS APP. This absence is itself the finding.
notes: The ONLY TV accessibility statement found lives in WIDGET DOCS and is scoped to embeddable web widgets. It never mentions iOS, Android, native apps, VoiceOver, or Dynamic Type.

result: Targets Section 508 and WCAG 2.2 Level AA; claims keyboard navigation, alt text, screen-reader compatibility
notes: Note the hedge: 'significant strides in achieving full accessibility for SOME of our widgets... For the remaining widgets, we're diligently working'. Conformance is partial and self-asserted. No VPAT/ACR found. No last-updated date.

result: No first-party or credible third-party assessment of VoiceOver support in the TV iOS app exists
notes: UNRESOLVED. For contrast, PEERS DO publish this: MetaTrader 5 for iOS shipped explicit VoiceOver support, and Robinhood published a VoiceOver accessibility post. TradingView has published no equivalent.

result: Dynamic Type support is UNDOCUMENTED; the only known text-size control is the in-chart 'Scales text size' setting
notes: UNRESOLVED. A canvas-rendered chart generally does NOT honour Dynamic Type, which is likely WHY the app-level scales text-size setting exists at all.

action: Recolor candles, background, grid, crosshair, scales
result: Extensive user-driven color control is the DE FACTO accessibility affordance - but there are NO built-in high-contrast or colorblind-safe presets
notes: MEANINGFUL FINDING: accessibility here is achievable but entirely DIY, requiring the user to hand-build a template. Red/green candle defaults are the standard deuteranopia problem and no preset addresses it.

result: No documentation of Reduce Motion handling
notes: UNRESOLVED. Relevant to chart pan/zoom inertia and toast animations.

result: No published minimum tap-target commitment
notes: UNRESOLVED. Circumstantial concern: mobile drawing requires tapping 'each anchor point in sequence', and precise anchor placement on a phone chart is an inherent MOTOR-ACCESSIBILITY burden.

result: Rated 16+ with an 'Unrestricted Web Access' advisory; no accessibility nutrition label information published
notes: Apple introduced Accessibility Nutrition Labels for App Store listings; TradingView's listing shows NO such declarations in the retrieved metadata.
